description: This file contains build configuration scripts and define macros for the OpenWrt build system, including commands for creating mklibs, managing opkg packages, cleaning installation scripts, and preparing root filesystem images.

methods.name: mklibs
methods.description: Builds shared libraries and program binaries for the target system, strips debug information, and copies the resulting libraries to the destination directory.

methods.name: opkg
methods.description: Defines the command options for the opkg package management system used in the build process.

methods.name: clean_ipkg
methods.description: Removes unnecessary files and resets the opkg status, preparing the package directory for new builds.

methods.name: prepare_rootfs
methods.description: Prepares the root filesystem directory by copying files, enabling/disabling init scripts, cleaning caches, and building libraries.
